en.title: Tova Translate — Camera Translator for China, No VPN
en.meta_desc: Scan menus and signs, talk with anyone, and see Hanyu Pinyin or Jyutping above every character. 118 languages. Works offline in China without a VPN.
en.og_desc: Scan menus and signs. Speak with anyone. Hanyu Pinyin for Mandarin, Jyutping for Cantonese, three-way Boardroom mode. Works offline in China — no VPN.
en.tw_desc: Camera, voice and text translator. Hanyu Pinyin for Mandarin, Jyutping for Cantonese, three-way Boardroom mode. Works in China — no VPN.

en.shot2_body: With Pro, Boardroom mode translates a three-way conversation, one speaker at a time.

en.lead: Point your camera at a menu. Talk to a taxi driver. Read a contract. Tova works in 118 languages — and keeps working when the network (or the Great Firewall) doesn't.
en.lp_body: Chinese: one hanzi a day, in the word it is used in. Japanese: hiragana and katakana a row at a time, then kanji one a day. Trace every stroke in the right order, then say it aloud — scored on-device. The phrases you save in Tova Translate become your study deck.
en.w_alt: Tova on an Apple Watch: the latest translation, “Excuse me”, with the Japanese すみません and its reading sumimasen, above a “Speak or type” field
en.rd_h2: You get how to say it, not just what it means.
en.rd_p1: Tova writes the reading above every character, in the system each language really uses: Hanyu Pinyin for Mandarin, Jyutping for Cantonese, Hepburn romaji for Japanese and Revised Romanization for Korean.
en.rd_p2: Cantonese is not Mandarin with an accent, so Tova does not give it pinyin. Pick 廣東話 and the reading is Jyutping, the romanization Hong Kong uses.
en.rd_alt1: Tova translating “Where should we go to eat?” into Cantonese: 去邊度食飯好 with the Jyutping heoi3 bin1 dou6 sik6 faan6 hou2 above the characters
en.rd_alt2: Tova camera reading a Japanese station sign: 東京駅 with the romaji tō kyō eki and “Tokyo Station”, and 出口 with de guchi and “Exit”
en.rd_alt3: Tova translating “Which platform?” into Korean: 몇 번 승강장 with the romanization myeot beon seung gang jang above the Hangul
en.ft_lead: Six things you will use on the first day of a trip. Every screen here is in the app today.
en.ft1_b: Signs, menus, tickets and labels in 11 scripts. The reading sits above each character and the meaning underneath.
en.ft1_alt: Tova camera reading a Chinese station sign: 北京站 with the pinyin běi jīng zhàn and “Beijing Railway Station”
en.ft2_b: No signal, or a network that blocks your usual translator? Tova switches to on-device translation by itself and tells you it did.
en.ft2_alt: Tova in aeroplane mode translating “Can I have a glass of water?” into Chinese with pinyin, marked “Translated on-device · no network used”
en.ft3_b: 29 phrase packs and a full Chinese dictionary, saved to your phone on home Wi-Fi.
en.ft3_alt: Tova's Offline packs screen: Chinese, Cantonese and Japanese downloaded, Korean and Thai ready to get
en.ft4_b: Ask “Do you take cards?” and Tova also shows the answers you are likely to hear, with readings, so the reply is not a surprise.
en.ft4_alt: Tova translating “Do you take cards?” into Korean, with a Common replies panel of four answers the other person might give
en.ft5_b: Your hotel address, your allergy, your usual order. Save them once and play them aloud any time. Five saves are free.
en.ft5_alt: Tova's Saved tab: “Hello” saved in Mandarin with pinyin, Cantonese with Jyutping, Japanese with romaji and Korean with romanization
en.ft6_b: Not only Chinese: Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Arabic, Spanish and more than a hundred others.
en.ft6_alt: Tova's language list with a search box for 118 languages: Chinese, Cantonese, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese and Arabic
en.mo1_b: Choose a picture from your library, pinch to zoom, and translate only the part you are looking at.
en.mo2_b: A note from your host or a chalkboard menu: tap the shutter and Tova reads handwriting too. It works best on iPhone.
en.mo3_b: Tova tells you what each dish usually is and which allergens to ask about. It is a guide: always confirm allergies with the staff.
en.mo4_b: Turn a translation into a full-screen card that flips to face the person across the table and can read itself aloud.
en.mo5_b: Google is the default. Pro adds DeepL, OpenAI and Baidu, so you can pick the one that reads most naturally in your language.
en.mo6_b: Open a PDF or photograph a page with several columns, and read it translated in the right order.
en.pl_h2: Most of Tova is free. Pro is for heavier trips.
en.pl_f2: Camera translation in 11 scripts, with readings
en.pl_f4: On-device translation when you are offline
en.pl_f5: 29 phrase packs and the Chinese dictionary
en.pl_p2: Unlimited keyboard translations and saved phrases
en.pl_p3: Common Replies and the phrase browser
en.pl_p4: Explain this menu, PDFs and document pages
en.pl_tp_b: Everything in Pro for one week. It ends by itself, so there is nothing to cancel. Made for a single trip.

en.hr_kb_b: Tova Keyboard translates inside WhatsApp, WeChat or Messages. Check the reading, then tap Replace.
en.hr_w_b: With Pro, dictate a phrase and read the translation on your wrist.
en.hr_off_b: No signal, or no VPN in China? On-device translation takes over by itself.

zh-cn.lp_body: 中文：每天一个汉字，放在常用词里学。日语：平假名和片假名一次学一行，之后每天一个汉字。按正确笔顺描写每一笔，再大声读出来，由设备端即时评分。你在 Tova Translate 里收藏的短语会自动变成你的学习卡片。

zh-cn.rd_h2: 不只告诉你意思，还告诉你怎么读。
zh-cn.rd_p1: Tova 在每个字的上方标出读音，用的是各种语言实际通行的注音方式：普通话用汉语拼音，粤语用粤拼（Jyutping），日语用 Hepburn 式（平文式）罗马字，韩语用韩国现行的罗马字表记法。

zh-cn.rd_alt3: Tova 把 “Which platform?” 翻译成韩语：몇 번 승강장，韩文上方标着罗马字 myeot beon seung gang jang
zh-cn.ft_lead: 旅途第一天就用得上的六件事。这里的每个界面，都是 App 里现在就有的。

zh-cn.ft3_b: 29 个短语包和一部完整的中文词典，趁在家有 Wi-Fi，先存进手机。
zh-cn.ft3_alt: Tova 的离线包界面：中文、粤语和日语已下载，韩语和泰语可供下载

zh-cn.ft4_alt: Tova 把 “Do you take cards?” 翻译成韩语，下方的“常用回复”面板列出对方可能给出的四种回答
zh-cn.ft5_t: 把用得上的句子存起来
zh-cn.ft5_b: 酒店地址、过敏的食物、每次都点的那一样。存一次，随时都能播放出来。可免费收藏 5 条。
zh-cn.ft5_alt: Tova 的“收藏”标签页：收藏的 “Hello”，有带拼音的普通话、带粤拼的粤语、带罗马字的日语和带罗马字的韩语
zh-cn.ft6_b: 不只是中文：还有日语、韩语、泰语、越南语、阿拉伯语、西班牙语，以及另外一百多种语言。
zh-cn.ft6_alt: Tova 的语言列表，带搜索框，可在 118 种语言中查找：中文、粤语、日语、韩语、泰语、越南语和阿拉伯语
zh-cn.mo1_b: 从相册里选一张图，双指放大，只翻译你正在看的那一部分。
zh-cn.mo2_b: 房东留的字条，或是写在黑板上的菜单：点一下快门，Tova 也能读手写字。在 iPhone 上效果最好。
zh-cn.mo3_b: Tova 会告诉你每道菜通常是什么，以及该问清哪些过敏原。这只是参考：过敏问题请务必向店员确认。
zh-cn.mo4_b: 把译文变成一张全屏卡片，可以翻转过来正对着桌子对面的人，还能自己朗读出来。
zh-cn.mo5_b: 默认使用 Google。Pro 另外提供 DeepL、OpenAI 和 Baidu，你可以挑一个在你的语言里读起来最自然的。
zh-cn.mo6_b: 打开一份 PDF，或拍下分成多栏的一页，就能按正确的顺序阅读译文。

de.lp_body: Chinesisch: ein Hanzi pro Tag, im Wort, in dem es vorkommt. Japanisch: Hiragana und Katakana Reihe für Reihe, danach ein Kanji pro Tag. de.mo2_b: Eine Notiz deines Gastgebers oder eine Speisekarte auf der Kreidetafel: Tippe auf den Auslöser, und Tova liest auch Handschrift. Am besten klappt das auf dem iPhone.

de.mo5_b: Standard ist Google. Pro bringt DeepL, OpenAI und Baidu dazu, damit du die Engine wählen kannst, die sich in deiner Sprache am natürlichsten liest.

tl.lp_body: Chinese: isang hanzi bawat araw, sa loob ng salitang gumagamit nito. Japanese: hiragana at katakana nang isang row bawat lesson, saka isang kanji bawat araw. I-trace ang bawat stroke sa tamang pagkakasunod, saka bigkasin nang malakas, at ang device mismo ang magbibigay ng score. Ang mga phrase na sine-save mo sa Tova Translate ay nagiging study deck mo.
tl.w_alt: Tova sa Apple Watch: ang pinakahuling translation na “Excuse me”, kasama ang Japanese na すみません at basa nitong sumimasen, sa itaas ng field na “Speak or type”
tl.rd_h2: Malalaman mo kung paano ito sabihin, hindi lang ang ibig sabihin.
tl.rd_p1: Isinusulat ng Tova ang basa sa ibabaw ng bawat character, sa system na talagang ginagamit ng bawat wika: Hanyu Pinyin para sa Mandarin, Jyutping para sa Cantonese, Hepburn romaji para sa Japanese at Revised Romanization para sa Korean.
tl.rd_p2: Hindi Mandarin na may ibang punto ang Cantonese, kaya hindi ito binibigyan ng Tova ng pinyin. Piliin ang 廣東話 at Jyutping ang basa, ang romanization na gamit sa Hong Kong.
tl.rd_alt1: Tova na nagta-translate ng “Where should we go to eat?” sa Cantonese: 去邊度食飯好 na may Jyutping na heoi3 bin1 dou6 sik6 faan6 hou2 sa ibabaw ng mga character
tl.rd_alt2: Camera ng Tova na nagbabasa ng karatula sa istasyon sa Japan: 東京駅 na may romaji na tō kyō eki at “Tokyo Station”, at 出口 na may de guchi at “Exit”
tl.rd_alt3: Tova na nagta-translate ng “Which platform?” sa Korean: 몇 번 승강장 na may romanization na myeot beon seung gang jang sa ibabaw ng Hangul
tl.ft_lead: Anim na bagay na gagamitin mo sa unang araw ng biyahe. Lahat ng screen dito ay nasa app na ngayon.
tl.ft1_b: Mga karatula, menu, ticket at label sa 11 script. Nasa ibabaw ng bawat character ang basa at nasa ilalim ang kahulugan.
tl.ft1_alt: Camera ng Tova na nagbabasa ng karatula sa istasyon sa Tsina: 北京站 na may pinyin na běi jīng zhàn at “Beijing Railway Station”
tl.ft2_b: Walang signal, o bina-block ng network ang karaniwan mong translator? Kusang lilipat ang Tova sa on-device translation at sasabihan ka nito.
tl.ft2_alt: Tova na naka-airplane mode at nagta-translate ng “Can I have a glass of water?” sa Chinese na may pinyin, may markang “Translated on-device · no network used”
tl.ft3_b: 29 phrase packs at kumpletong Chinese dictionary, naka-save sa phone mo gamit ang Wi-Fi sa bahay.
tl.ft3_alt: Offline packs screen ng Tova: na-download na ang Chinese, Cantonese at Japanese, handa nang i-download ang Korean at Thai
tl.ft4_b: Itanong ang “Do you take cards?” at ipapakita rin ng Tova ang mga sagot na malamang mong marinig, may basa, para hindi ka magulat sa isasagot.
tl.ft4_alt: Tova na nagta-translate ng “Do you take cards?” sa Korean, may Common Replies panel na may apat na sagot na puwedeng ibigay ng kausap
tl.ft5_t: I-save ang mga phrase na kailangan mo
tl.ft5_b: Address ng hotel mo, allergy mo, ang lagi mong order. I-save nang isang beses at i-play nang malakas kahit kailan. Libre ang limang save.
tl.ft5_alt: Saved tab ng Tova: naka-save ang “Hello” sa Mandarin na may pinyin, Cantonese na may Jyutping, Japanese na may romaji at Korean na may romanization
tl.ft6_b: Hindi lang Chinese: Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Arabic, Spanish at mahigit isandaan pang iba.
tl.ft6_alt: Listahan ng wika ng Tova na may search box para sa 118 wika: Chinese, Cantonese, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese at Arabic
tl.mo1_b: Pumili ng picture sa library mo, i-pinch para mag-zoom, at i-translate lang ang bahaging tinitingnan mo.
tl.mo2_b: Note mula sa host mo o menu na nakasulat sa chalkboard: i-tap ang shutter at babasahin din ng Tova ang sulat-kamay. Pinakamaganda ang resulta sa iPhone.
tl.mo3_b: Sasabihin ng Tova kung ano kadalasan ang bawat ulam at kung anong allergens ang dapat mong itanong. Gabay lang ito: laging i-confirm sa staff ang tungkol sa allergy.
tl.mo4_b: Gawing full-screen card ang translation na bumabaligtad para humarap sa taong katapat mo sa mesa at kayang basahin nang malakas ang sarili nito.
tl.mo5_b: Google ang default. Dinadagdag ng Pro ang DeepL, OpenAI at Baidu, para mapili mo ang pinakanatural basahin sa wika mo.
tl.mo6_b: Magbukas ng PDF o kunan ng litrato ang page na may ilang column, at basahin ang translation sa tamang pagkakasunod.
tl.pl_h2: Libre ang halos lahat sa Tova. Pro para sa mas mabigat na biyahe.
tl.pl_free_p: Hindi kailangan ng account · may ads
tl.pl_f2: Camera translation sa 11 script, may basa
tl.pl_f5: 29 phrase packs at ang Chinese dictionary
tl.pl_p2: Walang limit na keyboard translation at naka-save na phrase
tl.pl_p3: Common Replies at ang phrase browser
tl.pl_p4: Ipaliwanag ang menu, mga PDF at page ng dokumento
tl.pl_tp_b: Lahat ng nasa Pro sa loob ng isang linggo. Kusa itong natatapos, kaya walang kailangang i-cancel. Ginawa para sa isang biyahe.
tl.pl_note: Mga presyo sa US. Ipapakita ng App Store o Google Play ang presyo sa currency mo bago ka magbayad.
tl.hr_kb_b: Nagta-translate ang Tova Keyboard sa loob ng Messenger, WhatsApp o WeChat. Tingnan ang basa, saka i-tap ang Replace.
tl.hr_w_b: Sa Pro, mag-dictate ng parirala at basahin ang translation sa pulso mo.
tl.hr_off_b: Walang signal, o walang VPN sa China? Kusang papalit ang on-device translation.
